task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move CAR to BOX_TOP, pick it up, move to TEMP_TABLE, place it there, then move to BOX_MIDDLE, pick it up, move to INSPECTION_TABLE, and place it there. Finally, return to BOX_TOP to restore the stack by placing it back on BOX_BOTTOM.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is the top of the stack and can be picked directly
BOX_MIDDLE becomes pickable after BOX_TOP is removed
TEMP_TABLE is available as temporary storage
CAR can carry one object at a time
Navigation tolerance of 0.5m is sufficient for picking/placing
After placing BOX_MIDDLE on INSPECTION_TABLE, we need to restore the stack by putting BOX_TOP back on BOX_BOTTOM
rtdl: def task MoveBoxMiddleToInspectionTable(;){ state nav_success: bool; state nav_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=-1.8,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP",location_name="TEMP_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE",location_name="INSPECTION_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=-1.8,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP",location_name="BOX_BOTTOM";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
